semiconductor_relevance: High — AGC Inc. provides critical materials and processing technologies essential for semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: AGC Inc. is a key supplier of electronic materials in the semiconductor industry, offering advanced materials and processing technologies. Their product portfolio includes adhesives, epoxies, die attach compounds, underfill materials, and both conductive and non-conductive materials, as well as package substrates and abrasive materials for CMP and polishing processes.
capabilities: Adhesives and epoxies for semiconductor applications
Die attach compounds and underfill materials
Abrasive materials for CMP, grinding, lapping, and polishing
Quartz ware including silicon carbide and fused quartz glass
